# Load Reference Datasets needed for Quast and funannotate
Using NCBI genome search: 
[Debaryomyces hansenii](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/datasets/genome/GCF_000006445.2/)
[Meyerozyma guilliermondii ](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/datasets/genome/GCF_000149425.1/)
```{bash refseq, eval=FALSE}
# for Debaryomyces hansenii
# Download the reference genome from refseq .fna file 
wget -nc \
  -P data_debaryomyces/ \
  https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genomes/all/GCF/000/006/445/GCF_000006445.2_ASM644v2/GCF_000006445.2_ASM644v2_genomic.fna.gz

# Download the genome annotation file from refseq .ggf file 
wget -nc \
  -P data_debaryomyces/ \
  https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genomes/all/GCF/000/006/445/GCF_000006445.2_ASM644v2/GCF_000006445.2_ASM644v2_genomic.gff.gz

# Download the reference proteome from refseq .faa file 
wget -nc \
  -P data_debaryomyces/ \
  https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genomes/all/GCF/000/006/445/GCF_000006445.2_ASM644v2/GCF_000006445.2_ASM644v2_protein.faa.gz

# for Meyerozyma guilliermondii 
# Download the reference genome from refseq .fna file 
wget -nc \
  -P data_meyerozyma/ \
  https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genomes/all/GCF/000/149/425/GCF_000149425.1_ASM14942v1/GCF_000149425.1_ASM14942v1_genomic.fna.gz

# Download the genome annotation file from refseq .ggf file 
wget -nc \
  -P data_meyerozyma/ \
  https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genomes/all/GCF/000/149/425/GCF_000149425.1_ASM14942v1/GCF_000149425.1_ASM14942v1_genomic.gff.gz

# Download the reference proteome from refseq .faa file 
wget -nc \
  -P data_meyerozyma/ \
  https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genomes/all/GCF/000/149/425/GCF_000149425.1_ASM14942v1/GCF_000149425.1_ASM14942v1_protein.faa.gz
```

# Establish environments 
## Creates sequali environment 
```{bash seqauli-setup, eval=FALSE}

conda create -n sequali-env python=3.11 -c conda-forge
conda activate sequali-env
conda install -c conda-forge -c bioconda sequali=1.0.2
conda deactivate 
```

## Creates Flye environment 
```{bash flye-setup, eval=FALSE}
conda create -n flye-env python=3.10 -c conda-forge
conda activate flye-env
conda install flye=2.9.6 -c bioconda
conda deactivate
```

## Creates medaka environment
```{bash medaka-setup, eval=FALSE}
conda create -n medaka_final -c conda-forge -c bioconda -c nanoporetech medaka=2.2.1 python=3.10 -y
conda activate medaka_final
conda deactivate
```

# Sequali Initial 
Initial QC analysis of Raw reads 
Files required: raw long-read sequence data (fastq)
Output: html report
```{bash sequali-inital, eval=FALSE}
conda activate sequali-env
sequali --outdir outputs_debaryomyces/dh_sequali_reports data_debaryomyces/debaryomycesHansenii2025.fastq
sequali --outdir outputs_meyerozyma/mg_sequali_reports data_meyerozyma/meyerozymaGuilliermondii2025.fastq
sequali --outdir outputs_debaryomyces/dh_sequali_reports data_debaryomyces/debaryomycesHansenii2026.fastq
sequali --outdir outputs_meyerozyma/mg_sequali_reports data_meyerozyma/meyerozymaGuilliermondii2026.fastq
conda deactivate 
```

# Filtlong 
Use conda to install [filtlong](https://anaconda.org/channels/bioconda/packages/filtlong/overview) package. Allows filtering of long reads based on certain criteria. Ie. average Q score or size. 
```{bash filtlong-install, eval=FALSE}
conda install bioconda::filtlong=0.3.1
```

Run downloaded file to analyse using filtlong package based on the QC sequali html file:
Input files required: raw long-read sequence data (fastq)
Output: filtered long-read sequence data (fastq)
```{bash filtlong-filter, eval=FALSE}
filtlong --keep_percent 90 --min_length 1000 data_debaryomyces/debaryomycesHansenii2025.fastq | gzip > outputs_debaryomyces/filtered_debaryomycesHansenii2025.fastq.gz

filtlong --keep_percent 90 --min_length 1000 data_debaryomyces/debaryomycesHansenii2026.fastq | gzip > outputs_debaryomyces/filtered_debaryomycesHansenii2026.fastq.gz

filtlong --keep_percent 90 --min_length 1000 data_meyerozyma/meyerozymaGuilliermondii2025.fastq | gzip > outputs_meyerozyma/filtered_meyerozymaGuilliermondii2025.fastq.gz

filtlong --keep_percent 90 --min_length 1000 data_meyerozyma/meyerozymaGuilliermondii2026.fastq | gzip > outputs_meyerozyma/filtered_meyerozymaGuilliermondii2026.fastq.gz
```

# Sequali After Filtering
Input files required: filtered long-read sequence data (fastq)
Output: html report 
```{bash sequali-filter, eval=FALSE}
conda activate sequali-env
sequali --outdir outputs_debaryomyces/filtered_sequali_reports outputs_debaryomyces/filtered_debaryomycesHansenii2025.fastq.gz

sequali --outdir outputs_debaryomyces/filtered_sequali_reports outputs_debaryomyces/filtered_debaryomycesHansenii2026.fastq.gz

sequali --outdir outputs_meyerozyma/filtered_sequali_reports outputs_meyerozyma/filtered_meyerozymaGuilliermondii2025.fastq.gz

sequali --outdir outputs_meyerozyma/filtered_sequali_reports outputs_meyerozyma/filtered_meyerozymaGuilliermondii2026.fastq.gz

conda deactivate 
```

# Increase sequencing depth 
## Concatenate same yeast strain fastq files for 2025 and 2026 to increase coverage for assembly
```{bash file-cat, eval=FALSE}
cat outputs_debaryomyces/filtered_debaryomycesHansenii2025.fastq.gz outputs_debaryomyces/filtered_debaryomycesHansenii2026.fastq.gz > data_debaryomyces/debaryomycesHansenii_final.fastq.gz

cat outputs_meyerozyma/filtered_meyerozymaGuilliermondii2025.fastq.gz outputs_meyerozyma/filtered_meyerozymaGuilliermondii2026.fastq.gz > data_meyerozyma/meyerozymaGuilliermondii_final.fastq.gz
```

# Flye 
[Flye Documentation](https://github.com/mikolmogorov/Flye/blob/flye/docs/USAGE.md)
Input files required: filtered long-read sequence data (fastq)
Output: assembly.fasta and flye.log
```{bash flye-de-novo, eval=FALSE}
mkdir -p outputs_debaryomyces/flye_output
mkdir -p outputs_meyerozyma/flye_output

conda activate flye-env

flye --nano-raw data_debaryomyces/debaryomycesHansenii_final.fastq.gz --out-dir outputs_debaryomyces/flye_output --threads 8 --genome-size 12m --iterations 5

flye --nano-raw data_meyerozyma/meyerozymaGuilliermondii_final.fastq.gz --out-dir outputs_meyerozyma/flye_output --threads 8 --genome-size 12m --iterations 5

conda deactivate 
```

# Medaka 
[Medaka Documentation](https://github.com/nanoporetech/medaka)
```{bash medaka-execution, eval=FALSE}
# Ensure directories exist
mkdir -p outputs_debaryomyces/medaka_round1 outputs_debaryomyces/medaka_round2
mkdir -p outputs_meyerozyma/medaka_round1 outputs_meyerozyma/medaka_round2

# Activate your environment
conda activate medaka_final

# Debaryomyces
# Round 1 
medaka_consensus -i data_debaryomyces/debaryomycesHansenii_final.fastq.gz -d outputs_debaryomyces/flye_output/assembly.fasta -o outputs_debaryomyces/medaka_round1 -t 8 -m r1041_e82_400bps_hac_v5.0.0_model_pt.tar.gz

# Round 2 
medaka_consensus -i data_debaryomyces/debaryomycesHansenii_final.fastq.gz -d outputs_debaryomyces/medaka_round1/consensus.fasta -o outputs_debaryomyces/medaka_round2 -t 8 -m r1041_e82_400bps_hac_v5.0.0_model_pt.tar.gz

# Meyerozyma
# Round 1 2026
medaka_consensus -i data_meyerozyma/meyerozymaGuilliermondii_final.fastq.gz -d outputs_meyerozyma/flye_output/assembly.fasta -o outputs_meyerozyma/medaka_round1 -t 8 -m r1041_e82_400bps_hac_v5.0.0_model_pt.tar.gz

# Round 2 2026
medaka_consensus -i data_meyerozyma/meyerozymaGuilliermondii_final.fastq.gz -d outputs_meyerozyma/medaka_round1/consensus.fasta -o outputs_meyerozyma/medaka_round2 -t 8 -m r1041_e82_400bps_hac_v5.0.0_model_pt.tar.gz

conda deactivate
```

# Busco 
```{bash busco, eval=FALSE}
# for Debaryomyces hansenii 
mkdir -p outputs_debaryomyces/busco_debaryomyces

docker run --rm \
  -v "$PWD":/data_debaryomyces \
  -w /data_debaryomyces \
  ezlabgva/busco:v6.0.0_cv1 \
  busco -i outputs_debaryomyces/medaka_round2/consensus.fasta \
        -o outputs_debaryomyces/busco_debaryomyces \
        -l saccharomycetaceae_odb12 \
        -m genome \
        -c 8 \
        -f
        
# for Meyerozyma guilliermondii 
mkdir -p outputs_meyerozyma/busco_meyerozyma

docker run --rm \
  -v "$PWD":/data_meyerozyma \
  -w /data_meyerozyma \
  ezlabgva/busco:v6.0.0_cv1 \
  busco -i outputs_meyerozyma/medaka_round2/consensus.fasta \
        -o outputs_meyerozyma/busco_meyerozyma \
        -l saccharomycetaceae_odb12 \
        -m genome \
        -c 8 \
        -f
```

# Quast
```{bash quast, eval=FALSE}
# for Debaryomyces hansenii 
mkdir -p outputs_debaryomyces/quast_output

# unzip downloaded files.  
gunzip -k data_debaryomyces/*.gz

docker run --rm -v "$(pwd)":/data_debaryomyces -w /data_debaryomyces quay.io/biocontainers/quast:5.3.0--py313pl5321h5ca1c30_2 \
  quast.py outputs_debaryomyces/medaka_round2/consensus.fasta \
  -r data_debaryomyces/GCF_000006445.2_ASM644v2_genomic.fna \
  -g data_debaryomyces/GCF_000006445.2_ASM644v2_genomic.gff \
  -o outputs_debaryomyces/quast_output
  
# for Meyerozyma guilliermondii 
mkdir -p outputs_meyerozyma/quast_output

gunzip -k data_meyerozyma/*.gz

docker run --rm -v "$(pwd)":/data_meyerozyma -w /data_meyerozyma quay.io/biocontainers/quast:5.3.0--py313pl5321h5ca1c30_2 \
  quast.py outputs_meyerozyma/medaka_round2/consensus.fasta \
  -r data_meyerozyma/GCF_000149425.1_ASM14942v1_genomic.fna \
  -g data_meyerozyma/GCF_000149425.1_ASM14942v1_genomic.gff \
  -o outputs_meyerozyma/quast_output
```

# funannotate 
## Debaryomyces hansenii 
```{bash d-hansenii-funannotate, eval=FALSE}
mkdir -p outputs_debaryomyces/funannotate_prep

docker pull --platform linux/amd64 nextgenusfs/funannotate:v1.8.15

# Define reusable variables
IMAGE="nextgenusfs/funannotate:v1.8.15"
PLATFORM="--platform linux/amd64"
CPUS=8
INPUT="outputs_debaryomyces/medaka_round2/consensus.fasta"
SPECIES="Debaryomyces hansenii"  
STRAIN="KL2"      

# Step 1: Clean redundant/short contigs ("genomic dust")
docker run -u $(id -u):$(id -g) --rm -v "$PWD":/data -w /data $PLATFORM $IMAGE \
  funannotate clean \
  -i $INPUT \
  -o outputs_debaryomyces/funannotate_prep/assembly_clean.fasta

# Step 2: Sort contigs by length and standardize header names (scaffold_1, etc.)
docker run -u $(id -u):$(id -g) --rm -v "$PWD":/data -w /data $PLATFORM $IMAGE \
  funannotate sort \
  -i outputs_debaryomyces/funannotate_prep/assembly_clean.fasta \
  -o outputs_debaryomyces/funannotate_prep/assembly_sorted.fasta

# Step 3: Soft-mask repetitive elements
docker run -u $(id -u):$(id -g) --rm -v "$PWD":/data \
 -w /data $PLATFORM $IMAGE \
 funannotate mask \
 -i outputs_debaryomyces/funannotate_prep/assembly_sorted.fasta \
 -o outputs_debaryomyces/funannotate_prep/assembly_masked.fasta \
 --cpus $CPUS
 
# Step 4: Predict gene models using Saccharomycetes BUSCO models for training
docker run -u $(id -u):$(id -g) --rm -v "$PWD":/data \
  -w /data $PLATFORM "$IMAGE" \
  funannotate predict \
  -i outputs_debaryomyces/funannotate_prep/assembly_masked.fasta \
  -o outputs_debaryomyces/funannotate_out \
  -s "$SPECIES" \
  --strain "$STRAIN" \
  --busco_db dikarya \
  --augustus_species debaryomyces_hansenii \
  --protein_evidence data_debaryomyces/GCF_000006445.2_ASM644v2_protein.faa \
  --cpus $CPUS
```

## Meyerozyma guilliermondii 
```{bash m-guilliermondii-funannotate, eval=FALSE}
mkdir -p outputs_meyerozyma/funannotate_prep

docker pull --platform linux/amd64 nextgenusfs/funannotate:v1.8.15

# Define reusable variables
IMAGE="nextgenusfs/funannotate:v1.8.15"
PLATFORM="--platform linux/amd64"
CPUS=8
INPUT="outputs_meyerozyma/medaka_round2/consensus.fasta"
SPECIES="Meyerozyma guilliermondii"   
STRAIN="A.W.1"        

# Step 1: Clean redundant/short contigs ("genomic dust")
docker run -u $(id -u):$(id -g) --rm -v "$PWD":/data -w /data $PLATFORM "$IMAGE" \
  funannotate clean \
  -i "$INPUT" \
  -o outputs_meyerozyma/funannotate_prep/assembly_clean.fasta

# Step 2: Sort contigs by length and standardize header names (scaffold_1, etc.)
docker run -u $(id -u):$(id -g) --rm -v "$PWD":/data -w /data $PLATFORM "$IMAGE" \
  funannotate sort \
  -i outputs_meyerozyma/funannotate_prep/assembly_clean.fasta \
  -o outputs_meyerozyma/funannotate_prep/assembly_sorted.fasta

# Step 3: Soft-mask repetitive elements
docker run -u $(id -u):$(id -g) --rm -v "$PWD":/data -w /data $PLATFORM "$IMAGE" \
  funannotate mask \
  -i outputs_meyerozyma/funannotate_prep/assembly_sorted.fasta \
  -o outputs_meyerozyma/funannotate_prep/assembly_masked.fasta \
  --cpus "$CPUS"

# Step 4: Predict gene models using Saccharomycetes BUSCO models for training
docker run -u $(id -u):$(id -g) --rm -v "$PWD":/data \
  -v "$PWD/funannotate_db":/opt/databases \
  -w /data $PLATFORM "$IMAGE" \
  funannotate predict \
  -i outputs_meyerozyma/funannotate_prep/assembly_masked.fasta \
  -o outputs_meyerozyma/funannotate_out \
  -s "$SPECIES" \
  --strain "$STRAIN" \
  --busco_db dikarya \
  --augustus_species candida_guilliermondii \
  --protein_evidence data_meyerozyma/GCF_000149425.1_ASM14942v1_protein.faa \
  --cpus "$CPUS"
```

# eggNOG-mapper 

```{bash eggnog-setup, eval=FALSE}
# Create a dedicated Conda environment to install eggNOG-mapper and its fast sequence aligner (diamond):
conda create -n eggnog_env -c conda-forge -c bioconda python=3.10 eggnog-mapper=2.1.13 diamond=2.2.8
```


```{bash eggnog-execution, eval=FALSE}
# run eggNOG-mapper
eval "$(conda shell.bash hook)"  # initialize conda 
conda activate eggnog_env

EGGNOG_DB_PATH="eggnog_db"

# Debaryomyces
emapper.py \
  -i outputs_debaryomyces/funannotate_out/predict_results/*.proteins.fa \
  --output isolate_functional \
  --output_dir outputs_debaryomyces/funannotate_out \
  --data_dir $EGGNOG_DB_PATH \
  --decorate_gff yes \
  --excel \
  -m diamond \
  --cpu 8
  
# Meyerozyma
emapper.py \
  -i outputs_meyerozyma/funannotate_out/predict_results/*.proteins.fa \
  --output isolate_functional \
  --output_dir outputs_meyerozyma/funannotate_out \
  --data_dir $EGGNOG_DB_PATH \
  --decorate_gff yes \
  --excel \
  -m diamond \
  --cpu 8
  
  conda deactivate
```
